response.rationale: Multiple T1 meta-analyses (Adesope 2017, Yang 2021) and a T1 review (Dunlosky 2013) show retrieval practice raises achievement, T2 studies on successive relearning and pretesting agree, and the only T4 item (Deng 2015) is counted as both positive and negative but its text reports that unique Anki cards seen predicted Step 1 scores, so it is a partial, not a contradicting, result (Firecracker cards did not predict scores). Evidence is mostly experimental effects on achievement rather than correlational prediction, which slightly limits the fit to the word "predicts".
